native_result.HypoA: In Psychology, both original and replication studies primarily used student subjects (original: 82.4%, replication: 80.9%), but some also included community members (original: 7.4%, replication: 8.8%), anyone (original: 10.3%, replication: 5.9%), or online participants (replication: 4.4%).
native_result.HypoB: The domain is Social (discipline == "Social"). At the original-study level (one record per study, n = 74 Social studies) 83.8% (62/74) of original studies and 81.1% (60/74) of replications used student subjects, the closest match to the quoted 82.4% / 80.9%; at the lab-record level (n = 668 Social records) the shares are 82.0% (548/668) and 78.4% (524/668). Cognitive (75.5% / 81.6%, n = 49) and Economics (94.4% / 100.0%, n = 18) are excluded because at least one side is far from the quoted pair, and no `project` value fits (rpp 80.4/76.3, ml1 75.0/73.0, ml3 90.0/100.0, ee 94.4/100.0). Residual uncertainty: no subset reproduces 82.4/80.9 exactly (smallest total absolute gap 1.6 pts for Social at study level), so the domain identification is robust while the exact decimals likely reflect a slightly different unit/data version.
